canon_summary:
James stepped out of the Great Canopy for the first time, leaving the trees behind to walk onto the open hillside. Sitting on a warm boulder, he quietly watched a thin wisp of smoke rise on the distant horizon.
James left his boulder to journey further down the hillside, testing the open terrain and catching a faint metallic scent on the wind.
James ventured further down the hillside, discovering a strange metallic grey spine half-buried in the earth as the metallic scent grew stronger.
James discovered a heavy, hollow metal ring near the buried spine and ventured down to the edge of the Whispering Flats, where he heard a distant, rhythmic mechanical sound.
James ventured into the Whispering Flats and climbed a stone mound, where he caught his first clear glimpse of human civilization on the distant horizon—angular rooftops, a smoke-puffing chimney, and straight-edged structures.
James descended the rocky mound and crossed the Whispering Flats, following a straight path to a wire fence. There, he observed his reflection in a strange, oily puddle alongside the looming shapes of the human town.
James crosses the Outer Fence and finds himself standing on the gravel outskirts of the human town, leaving the Whispering Flats behind.
world_lore:
The Great Canopy is the vast, ancient jungle James has lived in his whole life. James's grounding ritual is closing his eyes to count three distinct sounds when nervous, and his habitual formal greeting to any unfamiliar horizon is: 'Pleased to meet you, whatever comes next.'
The lower hillside features buried metallic spines of unknown origin near grey-green flats.
The Whispering Flats: the local name for the vast, grey-green valley stretching out from the foot of the hills, feared or avoided by the inhabitants of the Great Canopy.
The Outer Fence: A line of tall wooden posts and humming, rusted wire that marks the boundary between the Whispering Flats and the outskirts of human civilization.
The Border Gravel: The crushed, unnatural path that marks the first true transition point between the wild Whispering Flats and the structured environment of the human town.
next_beat: By day 6, James should reach the outskirts of human civilization. By day 7, he should lose the metal ring and see his first human. By day 9, he should meet the first human up close, and by day 10, they should become his first friend who will help him navigate the human world.
